name: Stone Statue Trap (CR 6)
body:
Stone Statue Trap

CR 6

XP 2,400

Type magical; Perception DC 26; Disable Device DC 26

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset none

Effect spell effect (flesh to stone, DC 19)

A statue of a tribal deity stands in a remote shrine. The first creature to touch the statue is instantly transformed into stone, forming a second stone statue trap.
